reason: Automates a constrained Skill self-evolution lifecycle by collecting redacted project experience, evaluating generated SKILL.md candidates in isolated DSH processes, and promoting or rolling back versions based on deterministic evidence.

summaries.zh: 该插件根据项目会话经验生成并隔离评估 Markdown Skill 候选，随后依据验证与监控结果自动晋级或回滚。
summaries.en: This plugin turns redacted project session experience into quarantined Markdown Skill candidates, evaluates them in isolated DSH processes, and automatically promotes or rolls back versions based on validation and monitoring results.

capabilities: Collects and redacts project session trajectories
Generates quarantined Markdown SKILL.md candidates using a configured model
Runs isolated baseline, candidate, and canary evaluations
Automatically promotes or rolls back Skills based on evaluation and monitoring results
Writes configuration, evaluation data, reports, proofs, and Skill versions under the project and DSH home
May invoke configured model providers, evaluation tasks, or an optional xskill bridge
